controles.affirmation: Incident cyber d'octobre 2023 : perturbation distribution dentaire/medicale Amerique du Nord et Europe, impact residuel en 2024, cible plus vulnerable, aucune garantie d'arret d'une attaque
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 (2026-02-24) : "In October 2023 Henry Schein experienced a cyber incident that primarily affected the operations of our North American and European dental and medical distribution businesses." ; "The incident had residual impact on our financial results in 2024." ; "We also may be perceived as a more vulnerable target of the cyber hackers as a result of the October 2023 incident." ; "there can be no guaranty that such measures will successfully stop any one particular cybersecurity incident given the constantly evolving nature of the threat."
